_doc: A21: full-tier texture caps (max px per slot) applied by build_assets.mjs before encoding. Normal maps are UASTC (about 70 % of a kit GLB's bytes and 1 byte/px on the GPU as BC7); in the Moon Gate's night look the props / statues / pillars read the same with half-size normals (docs/milestones/A21/README.md: before / after renders). Base colour and ORM (ETC1S) keep their size.
